info.title: UniRate API
info.description: API for currency conversion and exchange rates with historical data

get.description: Get exchange rates between currencies with optional amount conversion

get.summary: Get historical exchange rates for a specific date

get.description: Get time series data for a date range with optional amount conversion (max 5 years)

400.description: Missing parameters, invalid date format, or date range exceeds 5 years

parameters.name: base
parameters.description: The base currency for the time series data (optional). Defaults to USD.

parameters.description: The name of the JSONP callback function (optional). Only used when format is 'json'. Must be alphanumeric with underscores.

parameters.name: currencies
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of currency codes to retrieve (optional)

get.description: List all available commodity symbols with name and unit (Pro subscription required). 19 commodities: gold, silver, platinum, palladium (troy oz); WTI and Brent crude (barrel), US Henry Hub natural gas (MMBtu); copper, aluminium, zinc, nickel, lead, tin (tonne); wheat, corn (tonne), coffee, sugar, cocoa, cotton (kg). Precious metals are blended live from LBMA and market feeds; energy, base metals and agriculturals are World Bank reference prices (CC BY 4.0, attribution: The World Bank).

get.summary: Get historical commodity prices for a specific date
get.description: Get historical commodity prices for a specific date with optional amount conversion (Pro subscription required). Precious metals history back to 1968 (gold/silver) and 1990 (platinum/palladium); energy, base-metal and agricultural history accrues daily from 2026-08. 19 commodities: gold, silver, platinum, palladium (troy oz); WTI and Brent crude (barrel), US Henry Hub natural gas (MMBtu); copper, aluminium, zinc, nickel, lead, tin (tonne); wheat, corn (tonne), coffee, sugar, cocoa, cotton (kg). Precious metals are blended live from LBMA and market feeds; energy, base metals and agriculturals are World Bank reference prices (CC BY 4.0, attribution: The World Bank).

404.description: No data available for the given date or symbol

get.description: Get commodity time series data for a date range with optional amount conversion (max 5 years, Pro subscription required). Precious metals history back to 1968 (gold/silver) and 1990 (platinum/palladium); energy, base-metal and agricultural history accrues daily from 2026-08. 19 commodities: gold, silver, platinum, palladium (troy oz); WTI and Brent crude (barrel), US Henry Hub natural gas (MMBtu); copper, aluminium, zinc, nickel, lead, tin (tonne); wheat, corn (tonne), coffee, sugar, cocoa, cotton (kg). Precious metals are blended live from LBMA and market feeds; energy, base metals and agriculturals are World Bank reference prices (CC BY 4.0, attribution: The World Bank).

400.description: Missing parameters, invalid date format, or date range exceeds 5 years

500.description: Unable to retrieve time series data

parameters.name: api_key
parameters.description: API key for authentication (Pro tier required)

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of commodity symbols to retrieve (optional). e.g., XAU,XAG or BRENT,WTI,NATGAS. Defaults to all 19.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: The name of the JSONP callback function (optional). Only used when format is 'json'. Must be alphanumeric with underscores.
